integrity_notes: Proof reconstructed from hyperelliptic canonical geometry, Riemann–Roch, the Abel–Jacobi projective-bundle description, and adjunction.
A residual priority risk remains because the result is a short geometric refinement that may be implicit in standard literature.
limitations: Only smooth projective genus-two curves over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero are treated.
The result concerns Q_3(C) inside Sym^3(C), not a locus in Pic^3 of the spectral curve or the wobbly divisor itself.

title: The genus-two degree-three bicanonical incidence divisor
